info.title: Smart Water Pump Monitoring System (SWPMS) API
info.description:
### PT Ascon Multi Pratama - Industrial IoT & Water Pump Monitoring Dashboard

SWPMS is a centralized, real-time, and historical water pump monitoring backend platform.
This API provides full operational telemetry queries, dynamic site/area/device/sensor topology management, alarm rule evaluation, audit logging, CSV reporting, and controlled commanded pump ON/OFF power operations.

#### Authentication
Use the `/api/v1/auth/login` endpoint to obtain a JWT Bearer token.
Provide the token in the header:
`Authorization: Bearer <your_jwt_token>`

#### Postman Import Instructions
You can import this entire API into Postman directly by choosing **Import -> Link** and pasting:
`http://localhost:3000/docs/json` or downloading the OpenAPI specification from `/docs/json`.

get.description: Checks database connectivity and MQTT broker connection status.

post.description: Register a new user account with email, password, and role. Returns an access token immediately.
Authenticate with email and password to receive a JWT Bearer access token.

get.description: Returns the current user profile, assigned role, and permissions from the JWT token.

post.description: Invalidates session / logs out the user and records audit log.

get.description: Returns real-time aggregated counts for sites, devices, pumps, and active alarms.
Returns a list of all sites with pagination and optional search filter.
Returns device counts, pump status counts, and alarm summary for a specific site.

get.summary: Site Assets Overview with Live State
get.description: Returns all assets in the site with their current operating state, latest metrics, and area.
Returns all rooms/areas, optionally filtered by site_id.
Returns sensors (e.g. water level, room ambient temperature) assigned to this area.
Returns all MQTT gateways/devices with connectivity status and site metadata.
Calculates real-time health (ONLINE, STALE, OFFLINE) based on last_seen_at timestamp.
Returns all assets/pumps with their live state, area, and device mapping.
Returns real-time operational status, latest telemetry metrics, quality, and control states.

get.summary: Get Pump Remote Control Capabilities & Availability
get.description: Checks if remote control is enabled, device online status, and any command currently in progress.

post.description: Sends a commanded ON/OFF request to the PLC/Gateway with acknowledgement tracking and timeout safety.

get.summary: Get Command Status by Command ID
get.description: Returns the execution state, timestamps, and response message of an issued command.
Returns all sensor instances with active bindings, metric mappings, and source devices.
Returns configuration-driven site -> areas -> assets with sensors and area_sensors as specified in PRD Section 20.

put.summary: Bind Sensor to Pump or Area
put.description: Binds a sensor to either an asset or an area. Replaces previous active binding.

get.description: Returns the catalog of all engineering telemetry metrics, units, and boundaries.
Returns time-series telemetry samples formatted as chart points per metric.

get.description: Returns alarms filtered by site, asset, severity, and status.

post.description: Operator acknowledges an active alarm with an optional investigation note.
Engineer/Admin manually marks an alarm as resolved with explanation.

get.description: Returns system, device, and pump event logs with filtering by severity and site.
Returns immutable audit logs of user actions and configuration changes per PRD Section 70.
Streams historical telemetry data as CSV file with custom date range and asset filters.

Connects browser to the live Server-Sent Events stream.
Pushes `telemetry.update`, `asset.state`, `asset.status`, `alarm.created`, `alarm.updated`, `device.status`, `command.updated`, and `event.created`.

Authenticate by passing Bearer token in header or as query parameter `?token=<jwt_token>`.
